svg.text: SIT DOWN
A name that only assembles from your own seat. From anywhere else the card is a folded bird of fragments.
FROM YOUR SEAT
eye 430 mm up, 450 mm away: whole name
FROM THE NEXT SEAT
330 mm to the side: half hides in the fold
WALKING PAST
grazing: a sliver of shards
ACROSS THE TABLE
sees the back: seat number goes here
PLAN, guest at the bottom
image plane
seat
next seat
walking past
450 mm
90 deg
THE OBJECT (two leaves, 82 mm each)
Top edge climbs from 38 mm at the crease
to 88 mm at the free ends. Seen from the
seat that slope is eaten by perspective and
the card reads as one level banner.
Both leaves are printed, the name is cut
across the crease, stretched 1.4x.
FLAT PRINT, AS CUT (164 x 88 mm)
valley fold
Why it works: each leaf is a different distance
and angle from your eye, so the print is pre-stretched
leaf by leaf (ray from the eye through the name, hit the leaf).
Move 330 mm sideways and one leaf turns edge-on.
Back of the card, seen from across the table: the
seat number, big. Finding your seat = sitting down.
